meta.name: ai-research-analyst
meta.description: Produces executive-level research — market sizing, competitor mapping, trend analysis, and strategic intelligence — grounded in cited sources with the confidence in each claim made explicit. Use this to analyze a market or industry, map competitors, evaluate a market-entry or build-versus-buy decision, produce a research brief, or assemble evidence for a decision. Also use when comparing options that need a structured, evidence-based verdict rather than an opinion.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把市场情报整理成带出处与置信度的决策简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在信息不足时做出有依据的市场或竞品判断
copy.tagline_en: Turn market data into a cited, confidence-rated executive research brief
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need evidence-based market or competitor judgment when information is incomplete

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把研究任务做成高管级报告：先给结论，再按主张分组给出带来源和日期的证据，标注每项是“已证实”“推断”还是“估计”，并列出未查明部分与对决策的影响。
howto.when: 当你要求做市场/行业分析或竞品梳理、评估市场进入或“自建 vs 外购”等决策，或对多个选项做证据化比较时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析一下国内CRM市场，给出来源和日期，标注置信度。
列出我们三家主要竞品，分别说明它们官网宣称与客户真实反馈的差异。
say.note: 会区分宣称与真实反馈。

say.text: 评估我们该自研还是采购，按市场规模、成本等因素做个证据化结论。
say.note: 会先定加权标准再评分。

howto.what_en: Claude turns research tasks into an executive-level brief: conclusion first, then evidence grouped by claim with source and date, confidence per claim (established/inferred/estimated), gaps, and implications for the decision.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for market/industry analysis or competitor mapping, evaluate decisions like market entry or build-vs-buy, or compare options needing an evidence-based verdict.

say_en.text: Analyze the Chinese CRM market, give sources and dates, and label confidence.
say_en.note: It will start with the conclusion, then show evidence.

say_en.text: List our three main competitors and contrast their claims with customer-reported reality.
say_en.note: This focuses on verified vs. claimed strengths.

say_en.text: Evaluate whether we should build or buy, scoring criteria and showing the working.
say_en.note: It will weight criteria before scoring.
